clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, laughing sisters' hair draws weavers seeking its natural magic. Kil'hala at the Crossroads uses the gathered locks to make enchanted robes.

Near Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale, laughing sisters are dryads whose hair holds natural magic. Dryads protect the woods and are linked to Cenarius and the night elves. Horde craftsmen prize their hair as a potent crafting material. Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads, spins the locks into enchanted robes for Deino's promising pupils of the arcane.
